propositions: Author-facing guides incorrectly document a split between Success Criteria and Acceptance Criteria that no longer exists after the epic's vocabulary collapse.

The leaf-vs-container section rule in writing-a-passing-plan.md must be rewritten to describe containers by their actual requirement (child decomposition covering acceptance criteria) rather than directing authors to write a heading nothing reads.

All SC (Success Criteria) vocabulary must be removed from src/rebar/_guides/, docs/user-guide.md, and docs/llm-framework.md except for four permanent carve-outs (T2 pilot metrics, dod_uncertifiable concept, and plan_review_verifier files).
rebar explain plan must render the updated guide with no SC vocabulary and exit 0 after the rewrite.
